QUICK READ / PANTRIES & SHARED AMENITIES

Five essential tips for office interior flooring success.

Give everyday breaks a practical place.

Three ideas to take into your workplace conversation.

01 / 03

Map use at the busiest time

Consider how many people will prepare drinks, heat food, queue or sit down at once. Separate the active preparation route from places intended for conversation or a quiet break.

Next idea ↓
02 / 03

Coordinate the services

Water, drainage, power, ventilation and cleaning need to be part of the early brief. Confirm specialist and building requirements before fixing joinery or equipment positions.

Next idea ↓
03 / 03

Plan storage and care

Allow for consumables, waste sorting and the items that accumulate around shared facilities. Assign a practical maintenance and cleaning routine.

Put it in your brief ↗
A PRACTICAL TAKEAWAY

Before you decide.

  • List the equipment and busiest-use scenario.
  • Review service and cleaning access.
  • Keep food preparation separate from focused work.
